prompt:
GAME BACKGROUND, WIDE 16:9 LANDSCAPE, seen in FIRST PERSON from the eyes of a short man standing just inside the entrance (camera at about 1.55 m, looking straight ahead, natural perspective, no fisheye). NO people and NO animals anywhere in the image (characters are added later as separate layers). Detailed clean pixel art, larger flat colour areas, little texture noise. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no brand labels.
The village pub 'Birtul Unirea' in rural Oltenia, Romania, late on a rainy autumn night: a small former communist collective-farm village shop turned into a pub, shabby, real and a bit sad-funny.
LEFT THIRD: a long shop counter of old beige formica with chipped edges, running from the left foreground towards the back wall; on it an old mechanical cash register (blank), a big glass jar of pickles, a tray with upside-down beer glasses. BEHIND the counter: an EMPTY standing space for the barman (keep it clear), and tall dusty wooden shelves with tins of fish, jars, cheap spirit bottles WITHOUT labels, packs of biscuits, a few faded boxes.
CENTRE, against the back wall: an old CRT television on a high metal wall bracket (screen dark grey, switched off look), and right under it a tall glass-door beer fridge (vertical refrigerated display, its light off, bottles inside, NO logos), its power cable going into an old wall socket overloaded with adapters and a tangle of wires.
CENTRE-RIGHT: an EMPTY area of floor in front of the fridge for a small table with two seated men (added later), keep it clear.
RIGHT: a tall round standing bar table, empty; a few white plastic chairs stacked; an old tin wood-stove with a black pipe going into the wall; on the far right a narrow old wooden door to the toilet, slightly open.
Floor of old grey mosaic tiles with sawdust and wet boot prints. Walls painted oil-green on the lower half and dirty white above. Light: one long fluorescent tube on the ceiling (cold, slightly greenish white) and the warm glow of a small lamp above the counter; black rainy night outside a small window by the door. Cosy, shabby, real.
